description.value: Pluvio is an acclaimed boutique restaurant-and-rooms property in the heart of Ucluelet village, recognized as Canada's Best Destination Restaurant and one of Canada's 100 Best Restaurants. The hotel comprises just four spacious rooms (400+ sq ft each), two of which are ground-floor garden-view suites accessible via a ramp, set behind the restaurant beside a working kitchen garden. Guests are invited to dine, spend the night, and wake to a complimentary breakfast, with the Wild Pacific Trail and Pacific Rim National Park Reserve a short ride away.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Pluvio is a real, operating boutique hotel (4 rooms) with an attached fine-dining restaurant in Ucluelet. Room features listed on /rooms include 'High speed Wi-Fi' and breakfast is included ('enjoy breakfast on us'), and the on-site restaurant provides evening dining. No mention of bike storage, laundry, tools, or e-bike charging anywhere on the site. The /contact page references a winter closure (Jan 1–Feb 12, 2026) which is now past; as of May 28, 2026 the business is open.
concerns: Website /contact page notes annual winter closure (Jan 1–Feb 12, 2026 referenced explicitly); future directory users should be aware of seasonal closure each winter. This is now past for 2026.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating boutique hotel and restaurant in Ucluelet; all contact details confirmed via website. Winter closure (Jan–Feb) is a known seasonal pattern; business is open as of May 2026.
enrichment_extras.notes: Breakfast is included for room guests per /rooms page ('enjoy breakfast on us'), but no details on timing or whether packed/early options are available for cyclists. Two ground-floor Kitchen Garden rooms are accessible via a ramp. Pet-friendly rooms available with advance notice.
